definitions.data: run 20261019T132719+0900_f15e587290f6_11408fd6d27f. Main: verify/IFG-APPLE-SPLIT arm SPL. A4 also verify/IFG-APPLE-NBC arm SPLT (server flag --neighbour-contact-mm 20).
definitions.scenes: SPLIT failures = analysis/<arm>_ep*.json success == False: 211, 320, 526, 954, 979, 1313 (6). Controls (fixed by a geometry rule, not by results): ep250 + the two successful (success True, failure_mode 'ok') neighbour-type scenes with the smallest target-to-neighbour surface gap at request 0 (IFG-AUDIT-ATS per_scene.neighbour_surface_gap_mm), excluding 250 -> 126 (pear, 0.0 mm), 572 (banana, 1.0 mm).
definitions.request: request k (0-based) = planning row k of frames.jsonl = server chunk chunk_{k+offset}.npz (replay json server_chunk_alignment.block); seq = k+1 (= analysis hold[].seq). A1-A3 use requests whose summary grasp.state is 'latched' or 'closing' (pre-grasp). A4 uses k = 10..16 whatever the state.
definitions.reconstruction: TO input rebuilt with AG3S.trajopt.experiments.ta_offline.Run (server flags parsed from server_proc.txt by serve_safe.build_parser -> trajopt_config_from_args, robot model by build_constraint_robot_model, field by fixed_input_ablation.build_field from esdf_coarse/esdf/esdf_free grids, q_now from planning-row qpos, finger joint path from finger_joints.opening_norm). target_free_mask = the recorded target_permission.target_field_exclude (replaces the reconstructed one; differences counted). NBC: SceneSnapshot.neighbour_contact rebuilt from the record grasp.neighbour_contact (active, links prefix) with centre = summary manipulated.centroid, depth 20 mm, radius = collision.neighbour_contact_radius. Linearizer horizon = horizon.planned (16) with lookahead_from = horizon.lookahead_from (8), so the tail keeps only obstacle rows as in the server.
definitions.fidelity: recorded refined chunk, executed window (8 steps), linearizer worst_row on the reconstructed scene vs summary.to.metrics.clearance_m; |diff| <= 1 mm = faithful. Requests over 1 mm are flagged (fidelity_ok False) and reported with and without them.
definitions.row_value: h(k,q) = d_L(p_kq) - r_q - m_kq (the TO collision row, linearize._esdf_clearance): p = sphere centre of sphere q at plan step k (server FK), L = target-free layer when target_free_mask[q] else the main composed layer (coarse 20 mm -> fine 5 mm), r = sphere radius, m = row margin (esdf_margin 0; obstacle_margin 10 mm on obstacle-class rows; target-row margin; NBC -20 mm on selected finger rows).
definitions.active_constraint: A row (k, q) of the ESDF block over plan steps 0..15 is ACTIVE on a trajectory when h < 0 (inside the margin or penetrating). Penetrating = d_L - r < 0. Evaluated on two trajectories: (i) reference = the policy chunk the TO received (reference_chunk) -> 'active_ref' (the rows that force a correction); (ii) refined = the TO output (refined_chunk) -> 'binding_out' = rows with h <= +1 mm (at or past the bound at the solution). Only hand spheres exist (--links gripper, 270 spheres: ee_left/right, ee_finger_l1/l2/r1/r2). Tail rows dropped by the look-ahead rule (+inf) are never active.
definitions.gt_classes: GT at the planning-row MuJoCo state (model_transport.xml of the kit's snapshot, d.qpos = planning-row qpos, mj_forward), class distance = min signed distance over the class geoms (ifg_audit_ats.Scene: boxes / planes / cylinders analytic, meshes via mj_geomDistance to a 0.1 mm probe + 0.1 mm). Classes: target (apple collision + visual meshes), neighbour fruit (banana collision pieces; orange / pear collision + visual), crate (crate body), post (pick obstacle cylinder from the run's obstacle config, ifg_audit_ats.obstacle_of), table (table body), room (floor, walls, shelf: every other non-robot collidable geom), robot_other (robot collidable geoms except both grippers' geom sets 'hand' and 'inactive_hand' of the replay json). Reported groups: target apple / neighbour fruit / crate+post (reported also separately) / table / other (room, robot_other) / unknown.
definitions.attribution_rule_R1_primary: For an active row: c* = argmin_c |D_c(p) - d_L(p)| over the GT classes. Accepted when |D_c*(p) - d_L(p)| <= tol, tol = 10 mm if the layer's answering tier (CuroboEsdfField.answer_tier, target_free=True for target-free rows) is 'fine' or 'target_free', 20 mm otherwise (coarse, target_free_coarse, window_edge, outside, static). Not accepted -> 'unknown' (no GT surface at the distance the field reports: a false voxel or a field error > tol). 'ambiguous' flag: the second-best class also within tol and its |D - d| within 3 mm of the best; ambiguous rows stay with c* and are counted separately.
definitions.attribution_rule_R2_check: Field surface point s = p - d_L * grad_L / |grad_L| (target_free_gradient for target-free rows, gradient otherwise); class = argmin_c D_c(s) if min |D_c(s)| <= 10 mm, else unknown. Reported only as agreement with R1.
definitions.per_request_source: dominant source of a request = R1 class of its active_ref row with the smallest h (most violated); 'none' when the request has no active_ref row. Also the R1 class of the refined worst row in the executed window (the row that decides HOLD).
definitions.correction: fingertip displacement = max over executed steps 0..7 of |tip_refined(k) - tip_reference(k)| (mm), tip = midpoint of the grasping hand's two finger link origins by server FK (ta_offline.finger_mid; the MJCF/URDF left-finger swap does not change a midpoint).
definitions.hold: HOLD = the request's summary verdict has a reason with action 'hold' (cross-checked against analysis hold[].seq == k+1). Penetration (mm) = max(0, -summary.to.metrics.clearance_m * 1000) (TO view, executed window) and the geometric max(0, -(d_L - r)) of the refined window from the reconstruction.
definitions.palm_target_distance: |FK(hold link ee_<hand>) at q_now - GT target centre| (mm), GT centre = world position of the target collision geom (as ifg_audit_ats); the recorded grasp.evidence.reach_mm and grasp.neighbour_contact.palm_to_target_mm (NBC) are listed next to it.
definitions.row_counting: counts are (plan step, sphere) rows; also given as the number of requests with at least one row of each source.

notes: support plane: ta_offline.Run 은 한 번도 쥐지 않은 run 에서 filtered_cloud[support_mask] 에 맞춘 평면을 쓰는데, IFG no-grasp run 에서 그 법선 z 가 0.95-0.98 로 기울어 탁자 행이 obstacle 로 분류되고 +10 mm margin 을 받았다 (첫 수집 raw/ 에서 fidelity 초과 49 요청). 이 측정은 그 run 들에서 기록된 esdf_stats target_free ball.support_plane_z_m 의 수평면을 쓴다 (raw_v2/). raw/ 는 대체된 첫 수집이다.

fidelity 1 mm 초과 2 요청: SPLIT ep1313 k18 (기록 +10.32 mm / 재구성 +1.15 mm), ep320 k22 (기록 +4.50 / 재구성 -20.78 mm); 둘 다 has_target False, manipulated occluded. numbers.A1_A2_pooled 는 포함, A1_A2_pooled_fidelity_ok_only 는 제외.
HOLD 판정(summary verdict action hold)과 analysis hold[].seq == k+1 은 측정한 모든 요청에서 일치 (불일치 0).
NBC ep211 k10-14 의 기록(활성 행 · HOLD · 수정량)이 SPLIT ep211 와 같다; NBC 의 neighbour_contact 기록은 k15, k16 에서 active.
reference_chunk 의 활성 행은 계획 16 step 전체 (실행 창 0-7 + look-ahead 꼬리 8-15, 꼬리는 서버 규칙으로 target · 지지면 행을 뺀 뒤) 기준이다. 행마다 step 이 raw 에 있다.
HOLD 인 요청의 refined_chunk 는 실행되지 않았다; 수정량은 TO 출력과 정책 청크의 차이로만 잰다 (SPLIT ep211 k22, ep126 k12 는 0.0 mm).
GT 는 planning row 의 MuJoCo 상태 하나이고, 행의 구 중심은 미래 step 의 자세다 (물체가 그 사이 움직이면 GT 와 어긋난다).
unknown 행의 오차 최소 클래스(허용 밖)와 R2 결과는 numbers.attribution_checks_split_pre_grasp 와 per_scene.*.unknown_best_any / unknown_r2 에 있다.
ep211 실제 씬 figure 의 table 그림에서 HOLD 글자색 강조는 열 위치가 바뀌어 적용되지 않았다 (값은 같다).
작업 중 셸 변수 실수로 빈 파일 경로 /w2.out (426 B, argparse 오류 메시지) 가 생겼다; 안전 검사로 삭제가 막혀 남아 있다.
